chunks: Muhammad b. Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad b. Abi'l Qasim narrated to me from Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from Isa al-Nahri Yari from Abi Abdillah al-Sadiq from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
He who recognizes Allah and His greatness will have purified his speech, [purified] his stomach of food, and supported himself with fasting and standing in prayer.
They said: May our fathers and our mothers be your sacrifice, O Messenger of Allah — are these the friends of Allah?

He said: The friends of Allah are silent, and their silence is remembrance; they observe, and their observation is a lesson; they speak, and their speech is wisdom; and they walk, and their walking in the midst of the people is a blessing. Were it not for the term decreed for them, their spirits would not have remained settled in their bodies out of fear of punishment and out of desire for reward.

key_terms.أولياء الله: the friends of Allah — those closest to God through piety and devotion
key_terms.الآجال: the decreed lifespans — divinely predetermined terms of life
key_terms.عبرة: a lesson or moral insight — their observation yields spiritual understanding

ai.seo_question: Who are the friends of Allah according to Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet (s) describes those who truly know Allah: they purify their speech, restrain their appetite, and devote themselves to fasting and prayer. When asked if these are the awliya (friends) of Allah, the Prophet provides a beautiful description of their four qualities: their silence is remembrance, their gaze is a lesson, their speech is wisdom, and their very presence among people is a blessing. Their fear of divine punishment and longing for reward is so intense that only their predetermined lifespan keeps their souls in their bodies.

They said: May our mothers and our fathers be your sacrifice, O Messenger of Allah – are these the friends of Allah?

He said: The friends of Allah are silent, and their silence is remembrance [of Allah]; they observe, and their observation is a lesson; they speak, and their speech is wisdom; and they walk, and their walking in the midst of the people is a blessing.
